fix: Store the options as a shared slice so per-build and per-layout copies are reference-count bumps. Change line 813 to `options: RefCell<Rc<[T]>>`, init at line 962 with `options: RefCell::new(Rc::from([]))`, and in `sync` (line 880) assign `*self.options.borrow_mut() = config.build_options(&value).into();`. Line 1037 then becomes `let options = state.options.borrow().clone();` (an Rc clone), and line 1058 keeps `options.clone()` as a cheap Rc clone. The call `view(context, select.clone(), &options)` at line 1062 still coerces &Rc<[T]> to &[T]. Only text changes allocate, as before.

`TextEditingController::value()` (incular-text/src/editing.rs:401) clones the whole TextEditingValue, including its String, on every call. `sync` runs on every build of the autocomplete and clones only to compare text. Add a borrowing accessor such as `pub fn with_value<R>(&self, f: impl FnOnce(&TextEditingValue) -> R) -> R` (calling `self.changes.track()` first) and run the text comparison inside it, cloning `value.text` only when text_changed is true. The clone at lines 879 and 887 is already conditional.
